versions.name: Painting
versions.description: Patch, caulk, prime, and topcoat two real surfaces, choose harmonizing colors from the color wheel, tell enamel from flat and stain from varnish, and clean and store brushes and rollers properly.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
